question: Does the bounded-page iter_steps fix prevent a paused trajectory reader from blocking lease renewal on the same store?
classification: Deterministic systems regression test, not model-learning or capability evidence.
interpretation_limits: The pre-fix mutex plus generator-held connection is the negative control; it is expected to fail the heartbeat deadline.
The candidate reads at most 16 steps per page and releases the SQLite connection before yielding to a consumer.
The runner copies the exact hashed test to an isolated temporary directory so both source checkouts remain clean.
Three repetitions of one bounded test on one Apple M1 Pro host do not establish throughput, multi-process safety, or production-scale performance.
